```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 8,
                      fig.height = 4, dpi = 120, message = FALSE)
```

Catch projections from Stock Synthesis with uncertainty from the delta-method
multivariate log-normal (MVLN). For each catch and year,
\((\log SSF/SSF_{MSY}, \log F/F_{MSY})\) is bivariate normal with means,
standard deviations and correlation taken from the SS3 derived quantities and
their covariance. Everything that follows is computed from those five moments:

\[
P(F \le F_{MSY}) = \Phi(-\mu_F/\sigma_F), \quad
P(SSF \ge SSF_{MSY}) = \Phi(\mu_B/\sigma_B), \quad
P(\mathrm{green}) = \Phi_2(\mu_B/\sigma_B, -\mu_F/\sigma_F; -\rho).
\]

No sampling is needed for intervals, densities or Kobe probabilities. Draws are
used only for the phase plot.

Set `FLREBUILD_SSDIR` to a folder of `*_{catch}t.Rdata` runs (r4ss
`SS_output` objects, one per catch). The defaults are the 2026 North Atlantic
shortfin mako projections. Runs available only as ADMB `ss3.std`/`ss3.cor`
files can be read with `readSsStd()` and used in the same way.

```{r setup}
library(FLRebuild)
library(ggplot2)

ssDir=Sys.getenv("FLREBUILD_SSDIR",
  unset = "P:/rfmo/iccat/2026/SHK/Analysis/NSMA_projection/SSoutput")
ssExists=dir.exists(ssDir) &&
  length(list.files(ssDir, pattern = "_[0-9]+t\\.Rdata$", ignore.case = TRUE)) > 0
hasKobe=requireNamespace("kobe", quietly = TRUE)

annYrs =2025:2070
k2Yrs  =c(2027, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2035, 2040, 2045, 2050, 2055, 2060, 2065, 2070)
densYrs=c(2026, 2028, 2030, 2050, 2070)
tacsFig=c(0, 250, 1200, 1883, 2300)
bOffset=1
```

`bOffset = 1` pairs \(F_y\) with SSF at the end of year \(y\) (SS3
`Bratio_{y+1}`), the convention of the ICCAT Kobe matrices; `bOffset = 0`
uses start-of-year SSF.

```{r load-runs, eval=ssExists}
runs=getRuns(ssDir)
tacs=sort(as.numeric(names(runs)))
grid=suppressWarnings(kobeMomentGrid(runs, years = annYrs, transform = "exact",
                                     bOffset = bOffset))
```

# Trajectories

Median and 50/80/95% log-normal intervals from the moments (`kobeCI()`).

```{r traj, eval=ssExists, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="SSF/SSFMSY and F/FMSY by catch: median and 50/80/95% log-normal intervals."}
plotKobeCI(kobeCI(grid[grid$catch %in% tacsFig, ]))
```

# Kobe II strategy matrix

```{r k2sm, eval=ssExists, fig.height=12, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Kobe II strategy matrix: P(F <= FMSY), P(SSF >= SSFMSY) and P(green) by catch and year."}
k2=makeK2SM(grid, years = annYrs)
k2$long$catch=as.numeric(k2$long$catch)
plotK2SM(k2smLong(k2$long, panels = c(pNoOverfishing = "P(F <= Fmsy)",
                                      pNotOverfished = "P(SSF >= SSFmsy)",
                                      green = "P(green)"),
              years = k2Yrs))
```

# Densities

Log-normal densities implied by the moments (`kobeMomentDensity()`). Zero
catch has no \(F/F_{MSY}\) density.

```{r dens, eval=ssExists, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Log-normal densities of SSF/SSFMSY and F/FMSY by year and catch."}
dens=kobeMomentDensity(grid[grid$catch %in% tacsFig & grid$year %in% densYrs, ])
ggplot(dens, aes(x, density, colour = factor(catch))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(quant ~ year, scales = "free") + scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density", colour = "Catch (t)") + theme_kobe()
```

# Phase plot

Draws from the MVLN in 2070 (`kobeDraws()`), for display only.

```{r phase, eval=ssExists && hasKobe, fig.height=6, fig.width=6, fig.cap="Kobe phase plot in 2070: MVLN draws for selected catches."}
kobe:::kobePhaseMar2(
  kobeDraws(grid[grid$catch %in% tacsFig & grid$year == 2070, ], n = 800, seed = 2070),
  xlab = expression(SSF / SSF[MSY]), ylab = expression(F / F[MSY]))
```

# Recovery curve

Last year in which \(P(\mathrm{green})\) crosses 0.6 or 0.7, interpolated over
catch (`kobeRebuildCurve()`).

```{r rebuild, eval=ssExists, fig.height=3.5, fig.cap="Recovery year against catch for target P(green) of 0.6 and 0.7."}
curve=kobeRebuildCurve(grid, catch = tacs, years = annYrs, target = c(0.6, 0.7))
ggplot(curve, aes(catch, rebuildYear, colour = factor(target))) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  labs(x = "Catch (t)", y = "Recovery year", colour = "P(green)") + theme_kobe()
```

# Catch meeting a target

```{r target, eval=ssExists}
tt=expand.grid(year = c(2045, 2070), target = c(0.6, 0.7))
tt$catch=mapply(function(y, t) kobeTargetCatchEmpirical(k2$long, y, t),
                tt$year, tt$target)
knitr::kable(tt, digits = 0, caption = "Catch (t) at which P(green) equals the target.")
```

```{r status, echo=FALSE}
if (!ssExists) message("SS output not found at ", ssDir, "; chunks skipped.")
```
